The '''Phibia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Haserian sector/Legends|Haserian sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Phibian beer]]s originated in this system.
